map.根据高层建筑火灾态势，推荐扑救战术、力量部署与供水方案: Recommend suppression tactics, force deployment and a water-supply plan from the high-rise fire situation.
map.云梯有效救援高度须 ≥ 着火层高度：ladderReach = 云梯高 ≥ 建筑: The aerial ladder must reach the fire floor: ladderReach = ladder height ≥ building height × (fireFloor/totalFloors); flagged super-high-rise when height > 100 m; the staging floor is set one below the fire floor: elevatorFloor = max(1, fireFloor−1).
map.1. 消防水泵接合器 + 室内消火栓竖管（首选）: 1. Fire pump adapter + indoor hydrant riser (preferred)
map.2. 沿外墙/楼梯间垂直铺设水带（≤100m）: 2. Lay hose vertically along the exterior wall/stairwell (≤100 m)
map.3. 中转水箱接力供水（超高层）: 3. Relay water supply via intermediate tanks (super-high-rise)
map.4. 消防车直接泵至水泵接合器: 4. Fire engine pumping directly to the pump adapter
map.着火层、着火层上层、着火层下层各部署一组力量: Deploy one team each on the fire floor, the floor above and the floor below
map.消防电梯停靠着火层下层，徒步登梯1~2层进入: Park the fire elevator at the floor below the fire floor and ascend 1-2 floors on foot
map.避难层作为中转集结、器材转运、伤员救治基地: Use refuge floors as relay staging, equipment transfer and casualty treatment bases
map.高层建筑火灾扑救极其复杂，本工具提供战术参考，实际指挥须依据现场情况与力量调度决: High-rise fire suppression is extremely complex; this tool provides tactical reference, and actual command must be decided by the on-scene situation and force dispatch.
map.📚 深度解析：高层建筑火灾扑救推演: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: High-Rise Fire Suppression Simulation
map.高层建筑火情侦察后按着火楼层部署内攻、防御、搜救与供水力量。: After reconnaissance of a high-rise fire, deploy interior-attack, defensive, search-and-rescue and water-supply forces by fire floor.
map.制定消防电梯停靠策略与竖向管井封堵措施，防止烟囱效应。: Develop a fire-elevator parking strategy and vertical shaft sealing measures to prevent the stack effect.
map.训练中队级指挥员熟悉「到场 5 分钟决策、每 15 分钟评估」的节奏。: Train company-level commanders to be familiar with the rhythm of 'decide within 5 minutes of arrival, reassess every 15 minutes'.
map.80 m 高层、15 层着火的力量部署: Force deployment for an 80 m high-rise with a fire on the 15th floor
map.按默认参数（建筑高度 80 m、着火层 15 层）：着火层（15 层）部署主攻组: With the default parameters (building height 80 m, fire floor 15): deploy a main-attack team of 2-3 on the fire floor (15) for interior firefighting; a defensive team of 2 on the floor above (16) to cut off upward spread; a search-and-rescue team on the floor below (14) to confirm no spread; manually control the fire elevator to park at floor 14, with personnel ascending 1-2 floors on foot to the fire floor; water supply uses fire engine → pump adapter → indoor riser as the preferred method, ensuring 6.5 L/s per nozzle.
map.为什么消防电梯要手动停靠？: Why must the fire elevator be parked manually?
map.火灾时消防电梯须由消防员手动控制并保持在指定楼层开门待命，避免自动返回基站或被烟: During a fire the fire elevator must be manually controlled by firefighters and kept waiting with its doors open at the designated floor, to avoid automatically returning to the base station or being invaded by smoke and fire, ensuring attack and rescue personnel can move up and down quickly and safely.
map.竖向管井为什么要封堵？: Why must vertical shafts be sealed?
map.管道井、电缆井等竖向连通空间会形成「烟囱效应」，使烟气与火焰沿井道极速向上蔓延；: Vertically connected spaces such as pipe shafts and cable shafts form a 'stack effect' that makes smoke and flames spread rapidly upward along the shaft; sealing them normally and closely monitoring them during a fire are key measures for high-rise fire control.
map.根据高层建筑高度、着火楼层、火灾阶段等参数，推荐扑救战术、兵力部署、竖向供水与疏: Based on the high-rise height, fire floor, fire stage and other parameters, recommend suppression tactics, force deployment, vertical water supply and evacuation plans.
